morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic exports plunge due to Iran conflict amid rising propane and infrastructure pressures.
what_changed: Ceramic exports dropped by Rs 3,589 crore over six months due to the Iran war.
Industrial propane gas prices rose by Rs 3 to reach Rs 104 per kg.
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park Twenty One for ₹1.21 crore.
stress_signals: Iran war impacts led to a massive Rs 3,589 crore drop in ceramic exports [19f71f3185bc].
Escalating propane prices (up by Rs 3 to Rs 104/kg) cloud tile makers' recovery [3d9aa30057b8, 9e8c549b7c05].
Overall export outlook remains weak despite shipments to the Gulf resuming [c2b4a2f5422a].
improvement_signals: Propane usage has resumed in the Morbi ceramic cluster [3d9aa30057b8].
Ceramic shipments from Morbi to the Gulf have resumed [c2b4a2f5422a].
Kajaria Ceramics invested ₹1.21 crore in a solar energy stake [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital utilization and debt servicing for export-oriented units facing revenue contractions.
Track further movements in industrial propane and gas input prices impacting operating margins.
Assess resolution of local infrastructure, power, and water representations submitted to the district minister.
